sourceNotes: Source PNGs are visual references only; boards are represented by editable SVG text, image, and rectangle nodes.
Embedded PNG image nodes are extracted losslessly and deduplicated by SHA-256.
SVG text geometry records the original x/y baseline and font properties; measuredTextBox uses the supplied local font.
